name: Tsukikage Reika
source:
Possessing the Magical Heart "Lapis Lazuli"
She wields twin swords named "Shamsheer Zomorodnegarl."

At Fukkou Academy, she serves as the Vice President of the Student Council. Her dashing demeanor makes her popular within the academy, and she holds a prince-like position. She comes from an old and prestigious family, which she takes great pride in. As a result, she harbors a strong sense of rivalry and complex towards Eris, the President.

Despite having a personality that is the complete opposite, she strangely gets along well with Senbazuru Izuna. They share a peculiar distance, having been physically close many times but never quite becoming lovers. She is sometimes teased by Izuna for having a smaller chest than Eris.
